data:text/html,<body><button onclick="oscillator.start()">Start sound</button><style>body{background:black;color:white;font-family:sans-serif}</style><script>const e=new AudioContext,t=e.createOscillator();t.type="sine",t.frequency.setValueAtTime(440,e.currentTime),t.connect(e.destination),t.start();</script></body>
